mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the unemployment rate above 5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer demand and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 2% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces earnings expectations and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below trend signals weakening manufacturing activity and lower corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a fall in payroll employment (PAYEMS) by more than 0.5% in the same month signals a tightening labor market with deteriorating employment conditions, which reduces consumer demand and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls by >0.5% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5% for three consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) below 1 million units signals a housing market downturn, reducing construction-related earnings and confidence, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) by more than 2% and 10% respectively in the same month signals a broad-based demand contraction, which reduces earnings expectations and equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < -2% and HOUST < -10% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.
